contract.identity: sourcebook + canonical tree + canonical talent name
contract.canonicalDescription: Source-backed Threats of the Galaxy rules text for the exact publication identity.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Malkite Poisoner|Malkite Techniques
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can apply a toxin to any nonenergy slashing or piercing weapon as a standard action. If an attack roll with that weapon also exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense, that target is poisoned. Each round on the creature's turn, the poison makes an attack roll (1d20 + your heroic level) against the target's Fortitude Defense. If the attack succeeds, the target takes damage equal to 1d6 + one-half your heroic level and moves -1 step along the condition track. A target moved to the end of the condition track by the poison is unconscious but continues to take damage as long as the poison continues to attack. The poison attacks each round until it misses or until the victim is cured with a Treat Injury check (DC 10 + your heroic level).
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, coat a nonenergy slashing or piercing weapon with a toxin that repeatedly attacks Fortitude, deals damage, and moves the victim down the condition track.
records.repoBenefit: If your attack exceeds the target’s Fortitude Defense, the target is poisoned; poison attacks each round with d20 + your heroic level vs Fortitude, deals 1d6 + half your heroic level damage, and moves the target down the condition track until it misses or is cured.
records.repoDescription: When your attack exceeds Fortitude Defense, you poison the target.
records.notes: Repository omits the once-per-encounter limit, standard-action toxin application, weapon restrictions, unconscious-at-track-end clause, and full cure/termination rules.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Malkite Poisoner|Modify Poison
records.canonicalDescription: You can modify the delivery method of a poison (contact, ingested, inhaled, injury) to another delivery method by succeeding on a Knowledge (life sciences) check (DC equal to the poison's Treat Injury DC). The poison's capabilities and specific effects are unchanged.
records.quickSummary: Change a poison's delivery method with Knowledge (life sciences) against its Treat Injury DC.
records.repoBenefit: You can modify a poison’s delivery method with a Knowledge (life sciences) check; DC equals the Treat Injury DC.
records.repoDescription: You may alter poison delivery methods with a successful Knowledge check.
records.notes: Core mechanic is aligned, but full source wording should replace summary-style text.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Malkite Poisoner|Numbing Poison
records.canonicalDescription: Any target you poison is automatically denied its Dexterity bonus to its Reflex Defense for as long as it remains poisoned.
records.quickSummary: Poisoned targets lose their Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense while the poison remains active.
records.repoBenefit: A poisoned target is denied Dexterity to Reflex Defense as long as they remain poisoned.
records.repoDescription: Poisoned targets are denied Dexterity to Reflex Defense.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Malkite Poisoner|Undetectable Poison
records.canonicalDescription: The Treat Injury DC needed to cure a poison you have used against a target increases by 5.
records.quickSummary: Increase by 5 the Treat Injury DC required to cure a poison you used.
records.repoBenefit: Increase the Treat Injury DC to detect or treat the poison by 5.
records.repoDescription: Increase the Treat Injury DC to detect your poisons by 5.
records.notes: Source increases only the Treat Injury DC needed to cure the poison. Repository broadens this to detection and/or treatment.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Malkite Poisoner|Vicious Poison
records.canonicalDescription: Any poisons you have used against a target gain a +2 bonus to their attack rolls made against that target's Fortitude Defense.
records.quickSummary: Your poisons gain +2 on attack rolls against the poisoned target's Fortitude Defense.
records.repoBenefit: Poisons you use gain +2 attack against the target’s Fortitude Defense.
records.repoDescription: Poisons gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls against Fortitude Defense.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi|Ignore Damage Reduction
records.canonicalTreeKey: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi
records.canonicalDescription: When you make an unarmed attack against a target that has damage reduction, and you deal more damage than the target's DR, you ignore the target's DR completely.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Teräs Käsi Basics, Martial Arts I
records.quickSummary: If an unarmed attack's damage exceeds the target's DR, ignore that DR completely.
records.repoBenefit: If your damage exceeds a creature's DR, you ignore that DR for that attack.
records.repoDescription: If your unarmed damage exceeds damage reduction, ignore the damage reduction.
records.notes: Repository omits Martial Arts I from the printed prerequisites.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi|Teräs Käsi Basics
records.canonicalTreeKey: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi
records.canonicalDescription: You deal an additional die of damage with your unarmed attacks.
records.quickSummary: Unarmed attacks deal one additional damage die.
records.repoBenefit: With Teras Kasi basics, unarmed attacks deal an additional damage die.
records.repoDescription: When making unarmed attacks, deal one additional die of damage.
records.notes: Mechanic is aligned; repository omits the printed diacritics in the talent/tree display names.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi|Teräs Käsi Mastery
records.canonicalTreeKey: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi
records.canonicalDescription: If you make only unarmed attacks during a full attack action, you can take the full attack action as a standard action instead of a full-round action.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Teräs Käsi Basics, Martial Arts I, Martial Arts II, Martial Arts III
records.quickSummary: A full attack made only with unarmed attacks can be taken as a standard action.
records.repoBenefit: Only full-round unarmed actions allowed; take full attack as a standard action.
records.repoDescription: When making only unarmed attacks as a full-round action, you may take a full attack as a standard action.
records.repoPrerequisites: Martial Arts I-III, Teras Kasi Basics
records.notes: Source permits a qualifying unarmed-only full attack as a standard action. Repository benefit text adds confusing/restrictive wording not present in the source.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi|Unarmed Counterstrike
records.canonicalTreeKey: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi
records.canonicalDescription: When you successfully parry a melee attack with the Unarmed Parry talent, you can immediately make an unarmed attack as a reaction against that target.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Teräs Käsi Basics, Unarmed Parry, Martial Arts I, Martial Arts II
records.quickSummary: After successfully using Unarmed Parry, immediately make an unarmed reaction attack against that attacker.
records.repoBenefit: If you parry a melee attack, immediately make an unarmed attack as a reaction against the attacker.
records.repoDescription: When you successfully parry a melee attack, make an immediate unarmed attack as a reaction.
records.notes: Repository lists only Unarmed Parry; source also requires Teräs Käsi Basics, Martial Arts I, and Martial Arts II.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi|Unarmed Parry
records.canonicalTreeKey: Threats of the Galaxy|Master of Teräs Käsi
records.canonicalDescription: When you fight defensively, as a reaction you can negate a melee attack by making a successful unarmed attack roll. If your attack roll equals or exceeds the attack roll of the incoming melee attack, the attack is negated. You must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed, and you take a cumulative -2 penalty to all attack rolls for each attack roll made since the beginning of your last turn.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Teräs Käsi Basics, Martial Arts I, Martial Arts II
records.quickSummary: While fighting defensively, react with an unarmed attack roll to negate an incoming melee attack, with cumulative penalties for repeated rolls.
records.repoBenefit: When fighting defensively, may negate a melee attack using parry; if successful and attack beats your melee attack, negate the attack and apply -2 cumulative attack vs others.
records.repoDescription: When fighting defensively, negate a melee attack with an opposed melee attack roll; cumulative –2 attack penalty against other targets.
records.repoPrerequisites: Martial Arts I-II, Teras Kasi Basics
records.notes: Repository omits awareness/not-flat-footed requirements and misstates the cumulative -2 penalty, which applies to all attack rolls for each attack roll made since the beginning of the user's last turn.

records.canonicalIdentity: Threats of the Galaxy|Dark Side|Drain Knowledge
records.canonicalDescription:
As a standard action, you can spend a Force Point to drain the knowledge of an enemy you touch; you must succeed on a Use the Force check (DC equal to the target's Will Defense) to activate this talent, and if you fail to activate this talent, you may not try again on the same target for one day. If successful, you immediately become trained in one skill that the target is trained in; if you are already trained in that skill, you instead gain Skill Focus in that skill. This training or focus lasts for one day. Additionally, your target moves -1 persistent step along the condition track, and the persistent condition can be removed only by resting for 8 hours.

Additionally, you can choose to instead sift through the mind of the target, looking for a specific piece of knowledge or information. Doing so requires you to make a Perception check against the target's Will Defense; success indicates that you pull the relevant information from the target's mind. When you do so, you do not gain the training or focus normally granted by this talent, but otherwise the talent functions as normal.

Using this talent increases your Dark Side Score by 1.
records.quickSummary: Spend a Force Point to drain a touched enemy's skill knowledge or specific information, inflicting a persistent condition and increasing your Dark Side Score.
records.repoBenefit: By touch, make a check vs target's Will Defense to drain knowledge; gain trained status in a skill or a Skill Focus if you already have the skill; target moves down the condition track; you gain a Dark Side Point.
records.repoDescription: Drain knowledge by touch, gaining a trained skill or Skill Focus; target moves down the condition track.
records.notes: Repository loses most of the published procedure: standard action, Force Point cost, Use the Force vs Will, one-day retry lockout, one-day duration, persistent-condition recovery, alternate Perception mind-sift mode, and full Dark Side consequence framing.
